intro.v: The people below all want to go ice skating. On the opposite page there are eight descriptions of places to go ice skating. Decide which place would be the most suitable for the people below.

content.v: Hamley Hall’s a 30-minute train ride from the city. With its wonderful gardens by the river and fantastic ice rink, it’s a perfect place for a day out. Art and sports classes are also available for kids of all ages. And in the evening, don’t miss the

Ice skating at Hill Road, with its spectacular views over the city, is popular with families. Special sessions are available for younger skaters, but everyone must keep to a sensible speed in the general sessions, too. There’s a hot drinks machine, and the bus from the city centre stops right outside.

Langley Skating Centre is a good place to spend a few hours, with plenty to entertain you. You can pay for a one-to-one session – it’s quite expensive, but you’ll improve quickly. There’s a restaurant right next to the ice rink, so you can get a good view of the action. It’s open all day, although it’s quieter in the afternoon.

At Ice World, you can do an hour-long skating class – places are limited to ten, so book early. It’s worth doing, as it’ll give you confidence to join in the games organised there every day – really enjoyable! Best of all, there’s a roof covering the whole skating area, so the fun never has to stop!

City Skate is always busy, especially at the weekends, when there’s a DJ. If you’re not very confident, arrange a lesson for either 30 minutes or an hour. It’s fun watching people speed around the ice, and there are good restaurants just ten minutes away. Check the weather forecast, as you’ll be skating in the open air.

Ice Park has a great central location, perfect for families wanting to explore the neighbourhood. Although the large skating area closes at 4 p.m., there’s plenty going on in the evenings, too, including the theatre with its great shows, and many fantastic restaurants.

Chorley Lane, located in the centre of the Financial District, is generally quiet, as the area isn’t a popular tourist destination. There’s something for everyone, though, with a smaller area for kids, and there are fun races for experienced skaters, which is a nice option if you’re skating by yourself.

Devon Park offers great skating, and you can rent everything you need on site. If you’re keen, you can get your own equipment here, too. This year, you’ll be entertained by bands until late into the evening, when the trees are lit up. It’s so magical that you’ll forget you’re in the heart of the capital!

content.v: Eighteen-year-old Jasmine Holloway writes about how she started her successful jewellery-making business.

When I was 15, I just wanted everything my friends had, and I never planned ahead – for example, I had no idea what I wanted to do when I left school. One day, my best friend got a new phone for her birthday and, of course, I thought I should have one, too. My parents said I could only have it if I paid for it with my own money, so I decided to work part-time and save as much as I could. I owe my parents a lot for making me do that – it taught me a really valuable lesson.

I worked every Saturday in a café, but I didn’t really enjoy it, so my parents suggested starting my own little business instead. I’d seen my mum making necklaces for herself, so I asked if I could have a go at that. I’d never imagined I’d find it so easy, as it had seemed so complicated when I’d watched Mum doing it. My friends thought it sounded dull, but I was really into the idea. Mum had shown me it was possible to create something attractive at home using basic tools and materials.

I sold my first items of jewellery to my friends and family as soon as I’d finished making them. They told me they were delighted with them, of course, but I just thought they were saying that to please me. So although I was grateful they’d bought them, I still needed convincing that they looked good enough to be popular with the public.

There was only one way to find out, so I rented a market stall with my mum. There are always lots of tourists where I live, and they bought lots of my things to give to family and friends when they got back home. Soon we were receiving calls from all over the country from people asking to buy more. They thought we were a big business, employing loads of people to produce my designs, when in fact we were just two people on a market stall! That was when I knew it could work, and it was time to take the next step and set up a website.
Since then, I’ve made thousands of pounds through my business, mostly online, although we still have our stall, too. It’s been such a lot of fun so far.

content.v: Have you ever gone to the coast for a lovely family day out – only to discover when you return home that you’ve lost something valuable and it’s probably still on the beach?
That’s exactly what happened to a young British boy called William during a beach trip. He put his camera on top of a rock so that he could make a video of himself and his sister playing.

So William and his family went home, with the camera still on the rock. Later, the sea flowed onto the beach and carried it away – about 800 kilometres away, in fact, to an island off the coast of Germany.
The camera was found on the island by the couple who live there. It’s a protected area for birds, and no one else is allowed on the island without permission.
However, things that the sea has brought in are regularly found there, like fishing equipment and even shoes. But it was still a surprise to find a camera!

Luckily, the camera was waterproof, so the seawater hadn’t damaged it. When the couple uploaded its contents onto their computer, they were amazed to see a video of William’s beach trip. The last few seconds, however, showed only the water around the camera.
The couple put one of the videos onto social media to see if anyone recognised it.
Then, amazingly, a special computer programme used for finding boats at sea recognised the exact place in the north of England where William had recorded the video!
A friend of William’s read about the video in a newspaper and told the family.
William and his father were invited to the island where the camera was discovered to see for themselves where it had finally ended up!
But that was exactly what they’d planned.
So there’s rarely anything left on the beach by visitors.
They hoped this would help them to find the person who’d filmed it.
But that isn’t all he expects to find.
It had begun its extraordinary journey across the sea.
Unfortunately, he then forgot all about it, and left it there.
